text:
incident-bot: Pager alert triggered: gpu-pool-prod-2 queue depth rising above 8000 reqs, 99p tail latency >= 12s, autoscaler hitting max_nodes (pool cap=48).
incident-bot: Linked alert: /alerts/gpu-queue-growth-2278504321

olivia_prod: paging SREs - noticed elevated 5xx rates from hosted API around 09:02 UTC. looks correlated with the v13 rollout last night. can someone pick this up? :rotating_light:

sam_sre: Im on it. pulling metrics. assigning to myself for now.

pagerduty-bot: On-call assigned -> sam_sre (primary). Incident priority: P1.

sam_sre: quick summary so far:
- GPU queue length spiked starting 08:55 UTC
- autoscaler attempted scale but stopped at pool cap (48).
- many requests are long-context generation (>= 8k tokens) and KV cache entries have ballooned.
- some customers seeing 502/503.

leo_support: customer impact: three paying customers (acct-A, acct-B, acct-C) reporting slow responses and failures on the /v1/chat/completions route. CS triage says ~12% error rate for those tenants in last 15m.

tanya_infra: looking at the autoscaler logs:
```
autoscaler: scale_request -> target 72 nodes
autoscaler: enforce_pool_cap -> max_allowed 48
autoscaler: scale_rejected -> quota_limit_hit
```
We tried to request more, cloud quota prevents scaling further.

raj_runtime: correlating with model metrics: v13 default config increased prefix KV retention for context expansion and we saw per-request KV size jump ~3.6x vs v12. that explains memory pressure and longer warmup times. also throughput per-GPU dropped ~18% on avg due to attention perf regression for long sequences.

kelsey_eng: if throughput dropped and KV cache per-session grew, that would increase concurrent occupied slots -> queue growth. do we have an immediate mitigation path? rollback v13? partial?

sam_sre: immediate mitigation plan (short term):
1) throttle long-context (>4096 tokens) requests via routing policy to reduce new pressure.
2) route non-critical traffic to v12 model variants (fallback) where possible.
3) temporarily increase pool cap/quota with cloud team (fast request) but assume that takes time.
4) if we can't scale, start shedding best-effort routes (internal/low-tier) to free capacity.

kelsey_eng: agree. I'm ready to trigger a rollback canary to v12 for the last deploy group. we should be conservative with full rollback. recommend canary -> 20% traffic, validate queue length drops.

sam_sre: doing 1 + 2 now. applying routing change to limit context length at the gateway and add 429 for over-limit.

sam_sre: command run:
```
# update route policy to cap context
redwoodctl routes update --route /v1/chat/completions --policy "max_context_tokens:4096, fallback_model:v12"
```
Response: OK 202 accepted.

tanya_infra: cloud quota request sent to infra billing team for temporary pool cap bump to 72 nodes. ticket #INFRA-8722. ETA unknown but emailed.

raj_runtime: also disabling KV-prefetch warmup heuristics for v13 to reduce warmup memory churn. patch pushed to runtime config; rolling restart of warmers scheduled.

sam_sre: starting selective shedding: drop non-critical model variants and internal batch endpoints. applying now.

incident-bot: automation log: route update: applied, shedding internal endpoints.

leo_support: CS update queued: "We are throttling very long requests and routing to fallback model to reduce latency. Minimal customer degradation expected, will follow up."

olivia_prod: thanks. can we quantify expected customer impact from the thottle/reroute? how many requests will be 429 vs serviced?

sam_sre: early estimate: ~9% of total requests are >4096; of those, ~60% belong to the three affected customers. most will now either be routed to v12 (approx 50%) or receive 429 (approx 10%). we'll send exact numbers in 10m after observing.

kelsey_eng: starting canary rollback to v12 at 09:22 UTC -> 20% of traffic for the last deploy group. watching queue metrics.

sam_sre: metrics 09:28 UTC: queue length down 34%, 99p tail latency decreased to 6.8s from 12s. errors per min dropping. autoscaler still at cap but utilization per-GPU improved.

raj_runtime: good signal. runtime logs show KV cache miss rate increasing slightly (expected) but overall memory freed.

tanya_infra: cloud asked for temporary quota escalation; they approved partial bump to 60 nodes while they review. raising pool cap to 60 now.

sam_sre: increased pool cap to 60. autoscaler triggered scale to 56 nodes. queues continue to drop.

leo_support: CS report: customers A/B/C seeing degradation ~reduced to 3% errors now, SLO impact limited to 15m window. they're asking for root cause summary and ETA for full fix.

olivia_prod: good. next actions: 1) maintain throttles/fallback for next 2 hours, 2) continue rollback canary to full if metrics stable, 3) postmortem to analyze v13 KV changes and performance regression.

sam_sre: acknowledging. handoff to night oncall at 11:00 UTC -> oncall rotation will monitor. I'll put a runbook in the thread.

sam_sre: runbook snippet:
```
- Check queue: dashboard -> GPUs > pool-prod-2 > queue
- If queue > 2000 and tail latency > 8s -> escalate to infra and ask for cap bump
- To throttle: redwoodctl routes update --policy "max_context_tokens:4096"
- To rollback: deployment rollback --group last --to v12
```

incident-bot: Note: incident declared. Incident lead: sam_sre. Severity: P1. Timeline window: 09:02 - 09:40 UTC (mitigated).

olivia_prod: assign action owners:
- root cause analysis: raj_runtime
- rollback coordination + release notes: kelsey_eng
- quota & provider escalation: tanya_infra
- customer comms + impact summary: leo_support

raj_runtime: will dig into why v13 increased KV retention and why attention perf regressed. initial hypothesis: change in context normalization + new preforking warmup. will instrument more.

kelsey_eng: will coordinate full rollback if canary stays healthy for 30m.

tanya_infra: will follow up on quota ticket and get permanent capacity plan if v13 stays.

leo_support: drafting customer messages now; will share for review.

sam_sre: handing off to oncall at 11:00 UTC. continuing monitoring for 2h. marking resolved for immediate P1 mitigation at 09:40 UTC (queues stable, errors down).

olivia_prod: thanks team. we'll post a full postmortem once RC done. +1 for quick response. :thumbsup:
